english.title: Registered firearm dealer fail to notify of sale of a shotgun properly
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with section 18(2) of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1988 in that the notice of transaction sent by you to the chief officer of police for **(..SPECIFY FORCE..) did not contain the particulars of the transaction which you, as a registered firearms dealer, were required to enter in the register kept by you under section 40 of the Firearms Act 1968, namely the

(A)_[number and place of issue of the purchaser's passport]_
(B)_[particulars of the agreement contained in a document produced under section 18(1A)(a) of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1988]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 18(5) of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1988.

english.notes: See also offence wording: H4345 re failure to notify sale of a Group II weapon and H4426 re failure to notify sale of a firearm properly.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
(Three months imprisonment where omission limited to that in 'particulars of the agreement' option).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
